newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber barely changed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber barely changed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were barely changed in after-hours trade on Tuesday, after falling during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen per kg weaker to 0.2 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark February was 0.1 yen up at 137.7 yen. Volume was 8,573 lots.
Amid a lack of fresh incentives, the market was spurred mainly by technical factors.
Earlier, prices extended losses in late trade, after the market saw the limited upside potential, pressured by rising domestic rubber stocks, traders said.
